name: Bulldozer Challenge
author: PlayerUknown01
description:
You've been contracted to clear an abandoned construction site to make way for a new park. Demolish as many buildings as you can before the timer runs out, but look out for the trees! 


Your score is calculated based on how much you tear down. If you do a great job, you can expect a fireworks show at the end!


Other Builds:
• Windows (higher quality and greater performance): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nXUD7CJ8ArwbNCkGpQ9nvuW8QX1ZnN3L/view?usp=sharing


Thank you for playing. Feel free to comment with your best score!
